summary: Full backend + frontend testing for link-ad platform. All 9 backend pytest tests pass (auth, sites CRUD, cards CRUD, reorder, /api/go redirect+click count, public resolve, auth enforcement). Frontend E2E via Playwright: admin login, dashboard listing (demo site present with 6 cards), create site + navigate to editor, appearance tab title edit, cards tab add-card flow, domain tab save with publish toggle, delete site, and public /site/demo rendering with 6 sponsor cards and correct title all worked.

issues: Sponsor card text has low contrast on the dark card background (particularly cards 3-6 look faded/washed out); the amber border color is barely visible against the dark background. Consider brighter text or a subtle background contrast per card.
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — a11y warning in console.

action_items: (Optional design) Improve sponsor card text contrast on public site so all 6 cards read clearly.
(Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to DialogContent components to remove console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_site: when data.domain is set to an empty string, existing domain isn't cleared explicitly — but code does set update['domain']='' when domain empty, so OK.
reorder endpoint does N sequential awaits — fine for small lists but could use bulk_write for large sets.
seed_admin resets password silently when env-vars differ from stored hash — acceptable per playbook idempotency.
CORS allow_origins uses '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject that combo; harmless here (JWT header) but should be explicit list for production.
seed_data_creation: Seeded on backend startup: admin user + Demo Reklam Sitesi (slug=demo) with 6 cards. UI test created & deleted a TEST_UI_Site.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 9 tests, all pass (~4s). Public URL: https://multi-domain-ads.preview.emergentagent.com. Auth: JWT Bearer via localStorage. All data-testids in the request are present and working.
rca of the issue: No critical issues found. Only cosmetic contrast on public site.
